messages:
eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1772345678 — high KV cache churn detected on rope-longctx clusters in us-west1. auto-pager fired.

sara: seeing continuous-batch queues ballooning, memory evictions on rope-worker-NTK pools. P50 ok but p95/p99 spikes.

dan: any customer impact yet?

sara: yes — a handful of streaming sessions show stalled chunks, some timeouts for retries. Support ticket queue has 2 premium customers reporting degraded throughput.

kevin: attaching quick dashboard links: https://grafana.redwood/intern/d/rope-longctx?panel=kv_churn and logs: https://logs.redwood/1772345678

mina: flagged customers: AcmeCorp (premium) + EduFlow. both are on dedicated pools but routed to longctx feature toggle. I'm opening SE tickets.

alex: root cause hypothesis? rope scaling + NTK sliding-window interacting with continuous batching KV cache — likely working set growth > cache_limits causing full-cache churn.

ops-bot: suggested mitigations: reduce continuous_batch.max_size, lower sliding_window.ntk, or disable longctx sliding window for affected model groups.

sara: I'm going to take a live mitigation: reduce batch size and temporarily disable sliding-window KV prefix caching for the longctx variant. will coordinate with dan for rollout.

dan: roger. prep hotfix config and ready to apply. will be a rolling config update to pool tag rope-longctx-usw1.

kevin: monitor plan: p50/p95/p99 latency, KV eviction rate, continuous_batch.queue_length, and number of retries. set alert thresholds to +20% over baseline.

sara: hotfix snippet I'm about to apply (pasting):

```json
{
  "model_variant": "rope-longctx-ntk",
  "continuous_batch": {"max_size": 8, "enabled": true},
  "sliding_window": {"enabled": false}
}
```

sara: applying via config service now: `curl -XPOST https://config.redwood/api/v1/pools/rope-longctx-usw1/patch -d @hotfix.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`

eng-oncall-bot: change submitted to config service, change_id=cfg-20240305-9881, deploying to 3/5 nodes for canary.

ops-bot: canary pass on node 1, node 2 shows reduced KV evictions.

dan: promoting to remainder of pool. throttling rollout to 30s per node.

kevin: metrics after canary: eviction_rate -70%, p99 latency down from 820ms to 240ms on canary nodes, continuous_batch queue length stabilized.

mina: informed AcmeCorp / EduFlow mid-rollout: "we're applying a targeted config change to mitigate long-context cache churn; expect latency improvements in <15m."

alex: any downside to disabling sliding-window? risk: slightly higher token processing cost for affected requests, potential short-term quality regressions for some long-context prompts.

sara: agreed. we'll keep sliding-window disabled until we have a planned fix: either increase KV capacity for affected pool or improve NTK windowing heuristics.

eng-oncall-bot: deployment complete. change_id=cfg-20240305-9881 rolled to 5/5 nodes. incident state: mitigated.

kevin: continuing to monitor. I'll keep a 30min watch and escalate if anything regresses.

mina: support updated customers: AcmeCorp acknowledged; will re-open if they see further issues.

dan: quick note for follow-up: collect a sample of requests that hit the evictions pre-hotfix (logs saved: s3://incidents/1772345678/eviction-samples.tar.gz) and run differential evals against sliding-window on/off.

sara: assigning postmortem owners: dan (lead), kevin (metrics), mina (customer comms). target: root-cause doc + action items in 72h.

alex: recommend follow-ups: 1) add circuit-breaker to sliding-window when working_set_growth > threshold, 2) auto-scale KV pool for NTK workload, 3) add canary that exercises long-context with high NTK during deploys.

ops-bot: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-9022 with action items and owners.

sara: closing on-call handoff to dan for follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:

dan: taking handoff. logging incident as mitigated, will update postmortem draft by EOD.

eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT 1772345678 status changed to mitigated.

sara: one last note — we should coordinate a scheduled maintenance window to test increasing KV limits on a staging longctx pool before enabling sliding-window again. I'll add to the ticket.

kevin: +1. I'll prepare the perf tests and a stable prompt corpus for regression detection.

mina: closing customer comms once postmortem has an ETA.

eng-oncall-bot: thread archived for incident 1772345678.
